verdict.rationale: Statsig's Console API reference has an in-page "Try it" control that sends live requests to the documented endpoint. It is backed by a public, versioned OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec that Statsig commits to keeping up to date, and the reference covers endpoints such as checking feature gates and logging events. The 404s on docs-domain OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is published on api.statsig.com. Missing for 10: the runner is directly evidenced only on the List Gates page, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Console API reference renders an in-page live request runner per endpoint
